title: Sections of a set-valued constant etale sheaf on a connected scheme
statement: Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field, let $U$ be a nonempty connected scheme [def-pc-scheme] over $\Omega$ [def-weil-connected-scheme], and let $E$ be a set. For the constant sheaf $\underline E$ on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], the canonical map $E\to\underline E(U)$ is a bijection. It is natural under every $\Omega$-morphism $v:V\to U$: the pullback of the section corresponding to $e\in E$ is the constant section with value $e$ on $V$, with no connectedness hypothesis on $V$.

source.place: Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5, label etale-cohomology-remark-constant-locally-constant-maps), the set-valued form: sections are Zariski-locally-constant maps and a locally constant map on a connected nonempty space is constant

proof.text: Apply [lem-galois-constant-sheaf-sets-representable] to obtain the represented sheaf, the constant-presheaf map c, and a sheaf isomorphism phi with eta followed by phi equal to c. At the terminal etale object (U,id), c(e) has underlying morphism the e-th coprojection. Evaluation of phi is bijective, so it suffices to prove that these coprojections give all morphisms over U into the coproduct, uniquely.

Apply the locally-constant-map equivalence and the constant-coprojection fibre formula in [lem-galois-coproduct-copies-morphisms-clopen] with W=U and s=id. Choose a point x of U using nonemptiness from [def-weil-connected-scheme]. The fibre formula implies that the locally constant map associated to the e-th coprojection takes value e at x. By Mathlib LocallyConstant.eq_const (the bundled form of [lem-weil-pbc-connected-locally-constant-map]), every locally constant map is the constant map with its value at x. Hence the coprojection map is injective by evaluation at x, and surjective by choosing that value and applying injectivity of the equivalence. Transfer this bijectivity to ULift of the Over morphisms by their left components, then cancel the bijective evaluated phi using eta followed by phi equal to c.

source.place: Remark 03P5 (remark-constant-locally-constant-maps): locally constant maps on a connected nonempty space are constant

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-constant-sheaf] directly to v:V->U and E. It supplies a sheaf morphism gamma, its IsIso proof, and exactly the required equation for every constant section at the base-changed terminal object. Promote gamma to asIso gamma and retain its equation. Neither connectedness of V nor a composition-unit compatibility theorem is needed in this combination.
